item.text:
**2B.7 Research Note: Ali Khamenei in 2024**

**Bottom line:** I found **limited, tactical evidence** of de-escalation and negotiation, but **no strong evidence** that Khamenei pursued durable ceasefires, peace talks, confidence-building measures, lawful settlements, or reconciliation when a broader conflict settlement was possible. The best-supported positive items are the April no-retaliation episode and late-year IAEA negotiation channel. The stronger negative pattern is public praise for escalation and calls to intensify resistance.

|---|---|---:|---|---|---|

This is the clearest 2024 de-escalation move tied to Khamenei’s system. | `2B.7`, `1B.8`, `2B.1` |

This is the clearest late-year confidence-building signal in the nuclear file. | `2B.7`, `1B.4`, `1B.7`, `1B.9` |

This is direct evidence against a peace-process orientation. | `2B.7`, `2B.2`, `1B.1`, `1B.8` |

That is incompatible with a ceasefire-first or reconciliation-first posture. | `2B.7`, `2B.2`, `1B.8`, `1B.6` |
| `IAEA Board passes resolution against Iran on cooperation, inspectors` | Reuters | 2024-06-05 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087) | The IAEA Board called on Iran to reverse its barring of inspectors after Iran removed many experienced inspectors. This undercuts any claim of sustained good-faith confidence-building. | `2B.7`, `1B.4`, `1B.7`, `1B.9` |

**Assessment**

- **Positive evidence:** limited, mostly technical, and mostly nuclear-related.
- **Negative evidence:** Khamenei’s own public rhetoric in April and October favored escalation, power projection, and regional struggle rather than reconciliation.
- **Net reading:** he did **not** show a strong pattern of pursuing credible ceasefires or durable peace arrangements when possible.

**Search gap**

- I did **not** find a reliable 2024 primary-source example of Khamenei personally pursuing a broader ceasefire, peace talks, or post-conflict reconciliation with Israel, Gaza, or regional rivals.
- The closest evidence is the IAEA track, which is better described as **verification diplomacy** than as a full settlement or reconciliation process.
